published_prior_art.cite: Marx2024SharpBounds gives uniformly sharp counterfactual-average bounds under full-and-closed complier support and expressly notes loss of joint attainability without it; it does not give the proposed finite no-full-support joint path set.

BeresteanuMolinari2008SVRV and ChernozhukovHongTamer2007ParameterSets provide regular identified-set asymptotics, not an iff survival criterion for disappearing components of a law-dependent nonconvex union.
RomanoShaikh2010IdentifiedSet supplies general identified-set inference; it does not supply the proposed contiguous rank-similar path-drop experiment or its fixed Hausdorff-separation consequence.
SongGuoChanRichardson2024CategoricalIV characterizes categorical-IV compatibility and convex-function inference, not exact inversion radii for common-parameter nonconvex rank-path unions.
FangSantos2019Directional supplies inference given a known or consistently estimable directional map; it does not recover the complete projected Hausdorff-loss germ for this law-dependent union.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 and project justification
soundness_flags.one_line: The claimed strict enlargement of Marx's domain is not presently an inclusion claim: removing full complier support is accompanied by a finite-outcome restriction, so state a finite-alphabet extension or prove an inclusion/transfer rather than a global strict extension.

soundness_flags.label: ass:observed-monotonicity
soundness_flags.one_line: Nonnegativity of c0 and c1 follows from latent-index monotone selection, uniform resistance, exclusion, and instrument independence; retain it as an observed-law compatibility definition/check, not as an additional maintained-model assumption.

source_verification_receipts.version: Author-hosted version of the 2007 Econometrica article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies estimation, confidence regions, and convergence rates for criterion-defined parameter sets.
The paper constructs asymptotically pointwise and uniformly valid random sets for identified sets and images of criterion-minimizer sets.
Under its assumptions and a Gaussian limit, standard-bootstrap consistency is equivalent to full Hadamard differentiability tangentially to the Gaussian support.
The paper gives bootstrap-calibrated projection confidence intervals for components and smooth functions of partially identified parameters in moment-(in)equality models.
The paper derives sharp treatment-effect-distribution bounds and asymptotics, notes possible standard-bootstrap failure, and studies a fewer-than-n bootstrap.
The paper gives a closed-form compatibility characterization for categorical IV models and confidence regions for convex functions of compatible joint counterfactual probabilities.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Rewrite Theorem 1 and the project justification as a finite-alphabet extension in the missing-complier-support direction, or add a formal inclusion/transfer result before retaining the phrase "strictly enlarges Marx's domain."
Move observed monotonicity out of the maintained assumptions and prove its cell inequalities as an initial compatibility lemma derived from the latent-index model.
Strengthen the discontinuity contribution from the single three-outcome family to a relative-face class of path-drop laws with a uniform non-shrinkage lower bound.
